# Social media and GPA

## 2. Literature review

Early studies reported negative associations (Kirschner & Karpinski, 2010; Junco, 2012). Lau (2017) found that multitasking predicted lower performance. Al-Adwan et al. (2020) studied Jordanian students — and found mixed results. A large Saudi sample showed sleep effects (Kolhar et al., 2021, p. 2218). Recent work confirms this (Haddad & Nasser, 2022).

أشارت دراسة الخطيب (2019) إلى أثر سلبي، كما وجد (Junco, 2012) نتائج مماثلة.
